messages:
Anya V: Heads-up — FinServe (customer) just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ + bespoke security questionnaire. They want answers in 48h (due 2026-02-12 COB). Main asks: data retention policy, audit log exports (90d), KMS/HSM key usage and key custody, recent incident history and SOC2. Link: https://uploads.finserve/sec-questionnaire-2026 (attached to ticket).

Sam (security): I can own the questionnaire. @Kyle I need exact wording for KMS/HSM (customer-managed keys, HSM attestation). Draft below, will iterate. Also need exported audit log sample for last 90 days and permanency policy.

Kyle I: Ok. Quick notes: Audit logs are retained 90 days by default for hosted; Dedicated/Private can configure longer via Console -> Observability -> Retention. To export logs: run:

```bash
rwdnctl logs export --org finserve --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-03-31 --type audit --format ndjson --out finserve-audit-2026.ndjson
```

We also keep request/response metadata (non-payload) for troubleshooting. Full payload retention requires explicit opt-in. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys in AWS KMS or GCP KMS. HSM-backed keys: we support CloudHSM via a KMS CMK with HSM origin; keys never leave HSM. Let me know if they want key wrapping proof or an architecture diagram.

Maria S: I have the contract SOW: FinServe has Dedicated seats; under SOW we retain logs for 90 days and we can arrange longer retention as an add-on. SOC2 report is in the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025.pdf. I'll attach to the questionnaire.

Jordan (sales): Can we ask for a 7-day extension? FinServe's security team is asking a lot. I can DM them. If they insist on 48h we escalate to legal.

support-bot: Ticket created #CS-9821 (FinServe - security questionnaire). Owner: Sam (security).

Sam (security): Draft answers (high level) — paste into CAIQ: "Data retention: Default 90 days for audit logs; payloads not stored unless customer opts in. KMS: Supports CMKs; HSM-backed keys using cloud HSMs; keys remain under customer control; we perform envelope encryption. Audit logs: accessible via export; immutable retention metadata; ingestion time + signer. Incident history: no PII-impacting incidents in last 24 months; we will include named postmortem on request (redacted)."

Anya V: Thanks. Action items: (1) Sam to produce CAIQ + bespoke answers (by 2026-02-11 12:00 PT). (2) Kyle to run export and upload sample (by EOD). (3) Maria to attach SOC2 and contract page. (4) Jordan to request extension if needed. I'll coordinate with FinServe PM. :eyes: 

Kyle I: Export job scheduled, uploading to secure share: https://redwood.internal/tmp/finserve-audit-2026.ndjson (ACL: finserve/sec-team + redwood-sec).

Sam (security): Uploaded draft CAIQ answers to drive: https://redwood.internal/caqi-drafts/finserve-2026.md — please review for technical accuracy. @Kyle: confirm HSM wording OK.

Kyle I: HSM wording looks good. Small tweak: change "keys never leave HSM" to "private key material is generated and stored in HSM and never exported in plaintext." I'll edit.

Anya V: Perfect. I'll send the completed package to FinServe and ask for extension if anything else comes up. Closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
